summary: Reference time validation check. Requires the gap float at this+0x14 to be non-negative and the stored reference time at this+0x1C to be non-zero, then compares that stored value against the current player vehicle pointer (dword_7C54E0) at offset 16592 or 16596 depending on the type flag byte at this+0x18. Returns 1 on a matching comparison, otherwise 0. Called by sub_4D9F80.

Non-zero guard on the stored reference time v1: a zero value blocks the comparison and returns 0
Type-flag branch on the byte at this+0x18: non-zero selects the vehicle+16592 comparison slot, zero selects vehicle+16596
Compare v1 against *(dword_7C54E0 + 16592), the first comparison slot of the current player vehicle pointer
Compare v1 against *(dword_7C54E0 + 16596), the second comparison slot of the current player vehicle pointer
Returns 1 when the selected comparison matches, otherwise 0; called by sub_4D9F80
